title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
summary: The bill would ban bets on war, assassinations and military operations amid concerns that traders could profit from inside information, as has already occurred.

title: Live news: Bitcoin hovers just above $61,000 as Anthropic slides after Nasdaq debut

title: Bitcoin bots pounced within seconds when researchers exposed their wallet keys
summary: University of Liège researchers put a few dollars into deliberately vulnerable bitcoin addresses and watched rival bots race for the money within seconds.

title: ECB’s Lagarde warns Europe could lose control of growing tokenized asset market
